headline: 28-unit multifamily redevelopment at 20-22 Goldthwaite Road approved with 35 parking spaces
summary: The project replaces a single-family home at 22 Goldthwaite Road and keeps a three-family at 20 Goldthwaite Road, with three of the 28 units affordable. The approval allows 35 parking spaces where 56 are required, and it drops a condition for an exterior door to the bike room. Also approved were a 12-unit building at 18-20 Crompton Street and two houses at 29 and 27C Firglade Street. Three items were continued or postponed to December 16, 2026.
decisions: Continued 23 Everton Avenue and postponed 18 Crown Street and 195 Mill Street to December 16, 2026.
Approved definitive site plan and private street improvements for 29 and 27C Firglade Street, with condition 3C amended and waivers granted.
Approved definitive site plan and parking special permit allowing 12 spaces at 18-20 Crompton Street.
Approved definitive site plan and special permit for 20-22 Goldthwaite Road, with condition 1B struck.
Approved special permit for an accessory dwelling unit over 900 square feet at 25 Gates Lane, with condition 1A changed and waivers granted.
Approved definitive frontage subdivision plan for 417-421 Cambridge Street.
Endorsed approval-not-required plans for 0 Myrick and 129 Blackstone River Road.
Approved payment of $3,530 to Horsley Witten Group for peer review of 1-3 Suburban Road.
discussion: Goldthwaite bike room door: Staff preferred an exterior door into the bike room to limit the doors a cyclist must pass through. The applicant's engineer said the door would add pavement in the front yard. Members agreed riders would likely ride into the garage, and the door condition was struck.

Firglade Street work: The applicant's representative said the owner cut trees and added gravel two years ago. Staff asked for 20 feet of width along the frontage so fire apparatus can be stationed there.

Suburban Road peer review invoice: The first invoice from Horsley Witten Group totals $3,530 for work from October through November 1, 2026. Staff said the amount matches the contract and the work delivered.

Gates Lane accessory unit size: The unit would be just over 1,000 square feet, above the 900-square-foot by-right limit. Staff said the request covers about 100 extra square feet, and the unit stays in the existing footprint.
